storeCopy.seoTitle: Apple App Store Reviews | Ratings & Comments
storeCopy.seoDescription: Scrape Apple App Store reviews by app ID. Export ratings, reviewer names, titles, comments, and dates to compare feedback across storefront countries.
storeCopy.intro: Collect public Apple App Store reviews with ratings, titles, author names, comments, and posting dates. Search several app IDs in one run and page through the review history.
useCases: App publishers can monitor recent customer feedback across product versions.
Product analysts can compare rating distributions and review themes between apps.
Market researchers can track public sentiment for competing mobile products.
howToUse: Add one Apple product ID per entry in `apps`.
Choose a storefront country and store type, then set review filters if needed.
Set `maxPages` and `maxResults` to bound the review collection.

faqs.question: Where do I find an Apple product ID?
faqs.answer: Copy the numeric ID from an App Store listing URL, or use Apple App Store Search Scraper to find a product first.
